purpose: Isolate whether the compact-rows MoE ids kernel causes the DS4 MXFP4 gate stream CPU-vs-GPU mismatch.
code_changes: When enabled with experimental DS4 stream, MXFP4/F8 rows use the existing per-row single-column MMVQ helper instead of ggml_cuda_moe_stream_mmvq_rows_dev.

compare_result.summary: First eight compare rows were identical to the rows-kernel, DONTNEED=0, and VRAM_CACHE_GB=0 runs.

conclusion: The dedicated MoE ids kernel is not the source of the DS4 MXFP4 stream mismatch. The remaining likely source is the MXFP4/q8_1 CUDA vec-dot or activation quantization layout; instrument per-block partial sums for one matching and one failing expert next.
next_steps: Add a lower-level diagnostic for MXFP4/q8_1 per-block partial sums.
Compare one matching expert and one failing expert using the same q8_1 activation representation consumed by CUDA.
Avoid another full-model type-gate trial until the block-level mismatch is explained.
